output_dir.description: Custom output directory instead of the default cde-package/

verbose.description: Enable verbose mode for debugging (corresponds to -v)

no_forks.description: Disable following forks; do not package child processes (corresponds to -f)

ignore_files.description: List of exact file paths to ignore (corresponds to -i); items are strings

ignore_prefixes.description: List of file path prefixes to ignore (corresponds to -p); items are strings
